messages:
Noah (Platform): heads up 1: user reported /v1/embeddings returning a generic 400 for mixed-dim payloads. they sent ~30 rows, 3 were length 0 or 512 and we dropped the whole request.
Priya (Eng-Platform): ouch. do we have any error metadata today?
Noah (Platform): nothing useful. just 'bad request'.
Ivy (SDK): SDK currently maps that to InvalidRequestError with the server string. we should surface an `error_code` and `hint` so clients can programmatically handle it.
Priya (Eng-Platform): suggested server error shape (flat): `code`, `message`, `invalid_indices`, `expected_dim`, `hint`. keep it flat for older clients. example: `{"code":"EMB_DIM_MISMATCH","message":"rows 4,12 invalid","invalid_indices":[4,12],"expected_dim":1536,"hint":"pad or remove rows"}`
Luca (Console): console can use that to show: 'Row 4 empty; row 12 length 512 (expected 1536)'. also show a redacted sample fix. important: never show raw vector values.
Ivy (SDK): two UX paths: (A) keep current semantics (fail whole batch) but add structured errors + client validator; (B) add `partial=true` to allow partial success with per-item statuses; (C) add a `preflight` validate-only endpoint clients can call before sending heavy payloads.
Priya (Eng-Platform): pros/cons: partial=true complicates billing and ordering. preflight avoids billing issues but doubles roundtrips. structured errors + SDK validator is least risk and quick win.
Noah (Platform): rollout plan: 1) implement structured errors + telemetry (non-breaking) 2) ship SDK validator and console hint integration 3) behind a feature-flag test `partial=true` with explicit billing UI if we go that route.
Luca (Console): console toggle: default = reject on any invalid rows. opt-in = partial responses (beta). show a card explaining how charges will be computed.
Priya (Eng-Platform): telemetry keys: `embed.ingest.count`, `embed.ingest.bad_count`, `embed.error.code`, `embed.ingest.avg_dim`. log redacted shape only (counts/dims).
Ivy (SDK): I'll open SDK draft to surface `error_code` and `hint` and add `validate_embeddings(payload, expected_dim)` helper. PR -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/462 (draft).
ci-bot: canary deploy scheduled: eng-platform/embeddings-errors-v1 -> 3%
Noah (Platform): target: structured errors + telemetry in canary by EOD. if we see many EMB_DIM_MISMATCH events we'll prioritize preflight next sprint. Thanks all.
